metadata_not_counted: Education adjustment and form controls remain necessary. Counts concern substantive predictors and source groups, not encoded columns or measured minutes.

GA_recipe_caveat.prior_MAE: Best inner MAE anchor, ties within1e-12 by burden, score count, mask. Threshold=anchor pooled MAE + sample-SD of its three fold MAEs / sqrt(3). Among visited masks within threshold+1e-12, choose smallest burden, then pooled MAE, score count, numeric mask.
GA_recipe_caveat.prior_R2: Anchor is minimum pooled MSE; anchor ties within1e-12 prefer burden, score count, numeric mask. Threshold=anchor MSE+sample SD of its three fold MSEs/sqrt(3). Among all visited masks at or below threshold+1e-12 choose burden, pooled MSE, score count, numeric mask, in that order.
GA_recipe_caveat.new_MoCA: Smallest pooled inner MSE; within1e-12 choose fewest optional source features, then additional instruments, then numeric bitmask. No one-SE allowance. The selected record equals the accuracy anchor.
